definitions.gloss: roar; blast; booming sound; thunderous noise
definitions.explanation: An extremely loud sound, originally referring to the sound of an explosion but now commonly used for any deafening noise such as engines, music, or aircraft.

examples.japanese: {爆音|ばくおん}で{音楽|おんがく}を{聴|き}く。
examples.english: To listen to music at full blast.

examples.japanese: バイクの{爆音|ばくおん}が{住宅街|じゅうたくがい}に{響|ひび}いた。
examples.english: The roar of a motorcycle echoed through the residential area.

examples.japanese: {戦闘機|せんとうき}の{爆音|ばくおん}とともに{窓|まど}ガラスが{揺|ゆ}れた。
examples.english: The windows rattled with the roar of fighter jets.

notes:
USAGE:
{爆音|ばくおん} literally means "explosion sound" but is widely used for any extremely loud noise. In casual speech, it often describes playing music at maximum volume.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爆音|ばくおん}で{聴|き}く (to listen at full blast)
- {爆音|ばくおん}を{立|た}てる (to make a thunderous noise)
- {爆音|ばくおん}が{響|ひび}く (a roar echoes)
- エンジンの{爆音|ばくおん} (roar of an engine)

FORMS:
{爆|ばく} (explosion) + {音|おん} (sound). Compare {爆発|ばくはつ} (explosion), {爆弾|ばくだん} (bomb).
